text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritised list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development allows teams to improve the product step by step and respond quickly to change.
